p1.coverage:
p1: points-only rule. Tiers searched completely, in order: (1 kind(s) of site, 1 sites), (2 kind(s) of site, 2 sites), (3 kind(s) of site, 3 sites), (4 kind(s) of site, 4 sites).
A choice of Wyckoff positions is kept when its points alone have exactly the symmetry p1 (tested at up to 48 random parameter values, seed 0); bonds = Voronoi neighbours; one entry per network. A network met in fewer than 4 % of the samples is ignored; one missed by every sample is not found.
